حَجَّةٌ : see حَجٌّ, in five places. ＝
-A2- Also, (IAar, K,) and ↓ حِجَّةٌ , (S, K,) the former of which is the word commonly known, (IAar in a marginal note in a copy of the S,) and ↓ حَاجَّةٌ , which is a subst. like كَاهِلٌ and غَارِبٌ, (L,) The lobe of the ear. (S, L, K.) ―
-b2- And the first, The bore, or perforation, of the lobe of the ear. (AA, TA.) ―
-b3- And A bead, or a pearl, that is hung in the ear; (K;) sometimes called ↓ حَاجَّةٌ . (IDrd, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
